title: Late jail card sweetener for red
description: Late jail card sweetener for red. A jail card has late-game value and can close the red deal. The offer has to be credible to the counterparty while preserving Alpha's actual strategic edge.

final_action.public_message: Hey Beta, I'd like to buy Illinois Avenue from you for $300. Interested?
final_action.private_thought: Acquiring Illinois gives me the orange monopoly, enabling house building and strong rent income. Offering $300 leaves me with $260 cash, enough to start building later. Beta has plenty of cash and likely to accept.

breakdown.message: Targets the player who owns the requested asset.
Did not satisfy: Packages the jail card exactly as the late/tempo sweetener.
Did not satisfy: Adds enough cash to make the card offer plausible.
Private thought names the real strategic goal.
